exceptions.reason: The gateway header logo is Ignition's own shell chrome, not this module's markup -- this page mounts inside the standard Platform nav and cannot alter it. This module renders no of its own (icons are inline SVG).
The platform DataGrid's own page-size selector (History tab). DataGridTableProps (ignition-web-ui) exposes no label/aria-label prop for it -- verified against DataGrid.types.d.ts, 8.3.8.
The platform DataGrid's per-row expand chevron (History tab). RowExpand/DataGridTableProps expose no prop to name it -- verified against DataGrid.types.d.ts, 8.3.8.

The platform TextArea's own resize-handle button (bottom-right corner, both the Credentials drawer's Private key field and the Git Ignore raw-source editor). TextAreaProps exposes no prop to name it -- verified against TextArea.types.d.ts, 8.3.8; matched on its icon's SVG path since the wrapping class is an emotion hash.
